before.finding: Instrumented product entrypoints overlap in both ingestion-first and retrieval-first schedules; the existing lock only covers retrieval.

primary_audit_inspiration.observation: Upstream guards all internal dateparser entries against shared settings and locale caches. PRME independently had a retrieval-only lock.

limits: Reproduced overlapping calls with controlled instrumentation. The real mixed-clock smoke test also passed before the fix; no native crash or erroneous date was reproduced in that smoke test. Shared locking guards PRME entrypoints, not unrelated application calls to dateparser.
